DECLARE

 --gen_pick_slip VARCHAR2(10); -- SCR 18714
 gen_pick_slip VARCHAR2(13);
 output VARCHAR2(7);
 select_ctr NUMBER;
 invalid CHAR(1):='Y';
 lv_num NUMBER:=0;
BEGIN
 GO_RECORD('1');
 LOOP
 IF :s_unit_id = 'X'
 THEN
 -- SCR 15596 : Exclude products based on vserv_customer_products table.
 SELECT COUNT(1) 
 INTO lv_num
 FROM vserv_customer_products vcp 
 WHERE :banner.hdr_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,:banner.hdr_date+10) AND 
 vcp.customer_id = :ctrl_blk.s_customer_id AND 
 NVL(vcp.consignee_id,:ctrl_blk.s_consignee_id) = :ctrl_blk.s_consignee_id AND
 /* Commented vide IM 6664 (Version 10)
 EXISTS 
 ( 
 SELECT 1 
 FROM orders ord
 WHERE ord.order_no = :ctrl_blk.s_order_no AND 
 ord.customer_id = :ctrl_blk.s_customer_id AND 
 ord.consignee_id = NVL(vcp.consignee_id,ord.consignee_id)
 ) AND 
 */
 (
 vcp.prod_code = SUBSTR(:ctrl_blk_1.product_code,1,5) OR 
 vcp.prod_type = :ctrl_blk_1.s_product_type
 ) 
 ;
-- message('in 2a '||lv_num||':cust :'||:ctrl_blk.s_customer_id||':ord :'||:ctrl_blk.s_order_no
-- ||':prd cd :'||SUBSTR(:ctrl_blk_1.product_code,1,5)||':prd ty :'||:ctrl_blk_1.s_product_type);
-- message('in 2a '||lv_num);
 IF lv_num > 0
 THEN
 invalid := 'N';
 --show_error_dist('3314'); -- Restricted product type -- Changed on 02/16/2012
 show_error_dist('3315'); -- Restricted product type(Warning)
 check_package_failure;
 EXIT;
 ELSE

 --remove_products;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 invalid := 'Y';
 END IF;
 EXIT WHEN :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD = 'TRUE';
 DOWN;
 END LOOP; 
 
 --IF invalid = 'Y' -- Changed on 02/16/2012
 --THEN

 GO_RECORD('1');
 LOOP
 IF :s_unit_id NOT IN ('X', '')
 THEN
 show_error_dist('0237');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;

 THEN

 THEN

 IF :s_order_no is NULL
 THEN

 IF output != 'SUCCESS'
 THEN
 EXECUTE_TRIGGER('key-clrfrm');

 END IF;
 generate_number('P','A',gen_pick_slip);
 :ctrl_blk.s_order_no := gen_orderno;
 :ctrl_blk.s_pick_slip_id:= gen_pick_slip;

 insert_order_patients;
 ins_upd_order_items;
 ins_pick_slip_products;

 -- ins_pick_slip_prod_antgn;
 upd_active_products;
 ELSE

 ins_pick_slip_products;
 ins_pick_slip_prod_attr;
 -- ins_pick_slip_prod_antgn;
 upd_active_products;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 EXIT WHEN :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD = 'TRUE';
 DOWN;
 END LOOP;
 IF select_ctr = 0
 THEN
 show_error_dist('0601');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 gen_report('SCRPICKS',:ctrl_blk.s_pick_slip_id);
 :system.message_level := 0;
 IF form_failure
 THEN
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error_dist('0600');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 show_error_dist('0000');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 --END IF; -- Changed on 02/16/2012
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DISPLAY_UNITS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure display_units is
/*This procedure displays all the Autologous and Directed Units
 which are pending for the Hospital*/
 v_local_time date;
cursor c_units is
 select ap.unit_id, ap.coll_date,
 ap.product_code, ap.aliquot,
 ap.product_type,
 ap.blood_type,
 ap.exp_date,
 substr(naa.pat_last_name||', '||naa.pat_first_name||' '||
 naa.pat_initials,1,20) name
 from
 special_patients naa,
 transf_details td,
 special_units su,
 active_products ap
 where td.ship_id = :ctrl_blk.s_consignee_id
 and td.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and td.pat_id = su.pat_id
 and td.surg_id = su.surg_id
 and su.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and su.unit_id = ap.unit_id
 and ''||ap.inventory_class = 'AD'
 and ''||ap.stock_state = 'AV'
 and ap.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and td.pat_id = naa.pat_id
 and naa.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 order by 7, 1, 3, 4;
begin
 go_block('ctrl_blk_1');
 for c_units_rec in c_units
 loop
 :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id := c_units_rec.unit_id ;
 :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date := c_units_rec.coll_date;
 :ctrl_blk_1.chk_digit := chk_digit_query(c_units_rec.unit_id,
 c_units_rec.coll_date,:GLOBAL.chapter_id);
 :ctrl_blk_1.product_code := c_units_rec.product_code;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_aliquot := c_units_rec.aliquot;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_product_type := c_units_rec.product_type;
 :ctrl_blk_1.blood_type := c_units_rec.blood_type;
 :ctrl_blk_1.exp_date := c_units_rec.exp_date; -- Uncommented by Kishore on 04/27/2012. IM 8509
 
 -- time zone change --03/04/11--sandip
 
 -- commented out by Edwin IM: 8493
 /* if Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(c_units_rec.exp_date,'DD-MON-RR HH24:MI'),'DD-MON-RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_exp_date := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'DD-MON-RR HH24:MI'),'DD-MON-RR HH24:MI');
 end if; 
 */
 
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_exp_date:=c_units_rec.exp_date;
 
 
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_patient_name := c_units_rec.name;
--Added this select statement to get abo description
 begin 
 select product_short_name into :ctrl_blk_1.s_product_code_desc
 from valid_products
 where product_code = substr(:ctrl_blk_1.product_code,1,5)
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate) -- Commented by Kishore on 04/27/2012. IM 8509
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) between 
 eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10) -- Added by Kishore on 04/27/2012. IM 8509
 and rownum = 1;
 exception
 when others then 
 null;
 end;
 begin 
 SELECT abo_desc
 INTO :ctrl_blk_1.s_code_desc
 FROM vserv_abo
 WHERE abo_code = c_units_rec.blood_type
 AND unit_scheme_type = decode(:ctrl_blk_1.chk_digit,NULL,'C','I')
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate); -- Commented by Kishore on 04/27/2012. IM 8509
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) between 
 eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10); -- Added by Kishore on 04/27/2012. IM 8509
 exception
 when others then 
 null;
 end;
 down;
 end loop;
 up;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_PRODUCT_PRICE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure get_product_price
 (pcode in VARCHAR2, edate in date, intier in number, cust in VARCHAR2,
 price out number)
is
 pr_type VARCHAR2(5);
 temp_cust_type VARCHAR2(2);
begin
 --
 if (pcode is null or
 intier is null or
 cust is null)
 then
 show_error_dist('0901'); -- Null parameters
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 --
 -- get product type and standard price from products table
 begin
--Modified for both schemes to coexist
 select distinct inv_product_type, nvl(std_price,0)
 into pr_type, price
 from vserv_products
 where product_code = substr(pcode,1,5)
 AND unit_scheme_type = decode(NVL(length(pcode), 0),5,'C','I')
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when others
 then
 tackle_error('Vserv_Products');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --
 if price = 0
 then
 -- get standard price for product type
 begin
 select nvl(std_price,0) into price
 from vserv_product_types
 where product_type = pr_type
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when others
 then
 tackle_error('Vserv_Product_Types');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 --
 -- get tier pricing for this customer
 begin
 select unit_price into price
 from product_pricing_matrix
 where chapter_id = :Global.chapter_id
 and product_type = pr_type
 and tier = intier
 and customer_id = cust
 and unit_price is not null
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 select customer_type into temp_cust_type
 from customers
 where customer_id = cust
 and customers.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 /* Modified by HCL CONSULTING */
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 if temp_cust_type in ('DI', 'RD', 'LC')
 then
 price := 0;
 return;
 end if;
 --
 -- get standard tier pricing for this product
 begin
 select unit_price into price
 from product_pricing_matrix
 where chapter_id = :Global.chapter_id
 and product_type = pr_type
 and tier = intier
 and customer_id = 'STANDARD'
 and unit_price is not null
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 null; -- get std price from products table
 end;
 end;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_TIER_LOC
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure GET_TIER_LOC(ptype in VARCHAR2, edate in date, tr out number) is
 shelf_life number := 0;
 temp_life_span number := 0;
 time_factor number := 1;
 min_tier number := 0;
 max_tier number := 0;
begin
 tr := 0; 
 -- get shelf life
 shelf_life := trunc(edate) - trunc(sysdate);
 --
 -- get min and max tiers
 begin
 select max(tier) into max_tier
 from product_pricing_matrix
 where chapter_id = :Global.chapter_id
 and customer_id = 'STANDARD'
 and product_type = ptype
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when others
 then
 tackle_error('Product_Pricing_Matrix');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 tr := max_tier;
 return;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_PRODUCT_PRICE_LOC
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure GET_PRODUCT_PRICE_LOC
 (pcode in VARCHAR2,intier in number, cust in VARCHAR2,
 price out number)
is
 pr_type VARCHAR2(5);
 temp_cust_type VARCHAR2(2);
 chap_id varchar2(15) := name_in('global.chapter_id');
begin
 --

 if (pcode is null or
 intier is null or
 cust is null)
 then
 show_error_dist('0901'); -- Null parameters
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 --
 -- get product type and standard price from products table
 begin
 select distinct inv_product_type, nvl(std_price,0)
 into pr_type, price
 from vserv_products
 where product_code = substr(pcode,1,5)
 AND unit_scheme_type = decode(NVL(length(pcode), 0),5,'C','I')
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when others
 then
 tackle_error('Vserv_Products');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --
 if price = 0
 then
 -- get standard price for product type
 begin
 select nvl(std_price,0) into price
 from vserv_product_types
 where product_type = pr_type
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when others
 then
 tackle_error('Vserv_Product_Types');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 --
 -- get tier pricing for this customer
 begin
 select unit_price into price
 from product_pricing_matrix
 where chapter_id = chap_id
 and product_type = pr_type
 and tier = intier
 and customer_id = cust
 and unit_price is not null
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 select customer_type into temp_cust_type
 from customers
 where customer_id = cust
 and chapter_id = chap_id
 /* Modified by HCL CONSULTING */
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 if temp_cust_type in ('DI','RD','LC')
 then
 price := 0;
 return;
 end if;
 --
 -- get standard tier pricing for this product
 begin
 select unit_price into price
 from product_pricing_matrix
 where chapter_id = chap_id
 and product_type = pr_type
 and tier = intier
 and customer_id = 'STANDARD'
 and unit_price is not null
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 null; -- get std price from products table
 end;
 end;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

procedure gen_report(program_name in VARCHAR2,

BEGIN

 temp_count := 0;
 begin
 select count(*)
 into temp_count
 from rpt_parm
 where appl_id = 'DON' and
 user_name = usr_id and
 report_name = program_name and
 parm_id = id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 If temp_count = 0 then
 begin
 insert into rpt_parm
 (appl_id,user_name,report_name,parm_id,
 parm_date,submit_date,report_status)
 values
 ('DON',usr_id,program_name,
 id,sysdate,sysdate,'E');
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 Else
 begin
 delete from rpt_parm_select
 where appl_id = 'DON' and
 user_name = usr_id and
 report_name = program_name and
 parm_id = id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 End if;
 
 begin
 insert into rpt_parm_select
 (appl_id, user_name, report_name, parm_id,
 parm_no, parm_select, parm_code)
 values
 ('DON',usr_id,program_name,
 id, 1, chap_id, 'CHP');
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 insert into rpt_parm_select
 (appl_id, user_name, report_name, parm_id,
 parm_no, parm_select, parm_code)
 values
 ('DON',usr_id,program_name,
 id, 2, id, temp_parm);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 copy('5','system.message_level');
 commit;
 copy('0','system.message_level');
 
 REPORT_GENERATE(lower(program_name),id);
 
 if form_success
 then
 show_error_dist('0000'); /* transaction committed */
 check_package_failure;
 else
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 show_error_dist('0600'); /* unsuccessful commit */
 check_package_failure;
 end if; 
end;

PROCEDURE REPORT_GENERATE(pl_rep_name in varchar2, pl_parm_id in varchar2) IS
parameters VARCHAR2(150) := NULL;
 command VARCHAR2(200) := NULL;
 temp_return number;
 filename varchar2(1000);
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dest_parm'; 
 rep_dir varchar2(30);
 temp varchar2(40);
 a_port varchar2(40);
 --val varchar2(2000);
 repid REPORT_OBJECT;

--for Apps server 
report_id Report_Object;
ReportServerJob VARCHAR2(100);
vc_rep_status VARCHAR2(100);
vjob_id VARCHAR2(100);

 -- Multiple reports server changes;
 l_svr_name VARCHAR2(70);
 l_err_msg VARCHAR2(200);
BEGIN 
 BEGIN 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id) ;
 end if ;

 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF; 
 END; 
 --message('number -1');
 
/* Get the report server name from the master code table*/
/* -- Commented on 04/12/2012; Ashok; Below code moved to LTRepServer_Lab.pkg

 BEGIN
 Select code_desc into val

 where code_type='OASVR'

 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1); 
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 message('Report server is not defined in the SYSPARM table for REPSVR');
 raise form_trigger_failure; 
 End; 
*/
--message('number -2');
 -- Added on 04/10/2012 to get least active jobs report server name.
 BC_CHECK_REPSERVER.get_reports_server( out_server_name => l_svr_name,
 out_error_msg => l_err_msg
 );

 IF l_err_msg IS NOT NULL THEN
 message('Err ' || l_err_msg);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 IF l_svr_name IS NULL THEN
 message('Error retrieving Server Name');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 ------------
--val:='rep_chdevsrv10_oracleas1'; 
--filename:=:rpt_parm.report_name||'_'||'_'||user;
 
filename:=pl_rep_name||'_'||pl_parm_id||'_'||LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid||'.pdf';
report_id:= find_report_object('LTREPORTS');
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_FILENAME,lower(pl_rep_name)); --'vdrinter.rdf');
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_COMM_MODE,ASYNCHRONOUS);
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_EXECUTION_MODE,BATCH);
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESTYPE,file);
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESNAME,filename);
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESFORMAT,'pdf');
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_SERVER,l_svr_name);
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_OTHER, 'paramform=no');

 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_PARM_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,pl_parm_id) ;
 add_parameter(pl_id,'NO_OF_COPIES',TEXT_PARAMETER,'1');
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_CHAPTER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:global.chapter_id);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'PRINT_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,NULL);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'HEADER_YN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'N');
 --add_parameter(pl_id,'DELETE_AFTER_PRINT_FLAG',TEXT_PARAMETER,:rpt_parm.delete_after_print_flag);
 --add_parameter(pl_id,'AUTO_PRINT_FLAG',TEXT_PARAMETER,:rpt_parm.auto_print_flag);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'RPT_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,upper(pl_rep_name));
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_USER',TEXT_PARAMETER,upper(:banner.user_id)); -- New parameter to allow the reports to run at a specified date and time
 
ReportServerJob:=run_report_object(report_id,pl_id);
vjob_id := substr(reportserverjob,length(l_svr_name)+2);
vc_rep_status := REPORT_OBJECT_STATUS(ReportServerJob);
--message('Status='||vc_rep_status);

message('Order Slip Report Submitted ... ');

/* Commented on 04/12/2012; Ashok -- Only submit the report; Cronjob will update the status of the report

WHILE vc_rep_status in ('RUNNING','OPENING_REPORT','ENQUEUED', null)
LOOP
vc_rep_status:=REPORT_OBJECT_STATUS(ReportServerJob);
END LOOP;

--message('number -3');

IF vc_rep_status='FINISHED' THEN
 
 update rpt_parm set report_status = 'C'
 where user_name = decode(substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,1,3),'OPS',substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,5),LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid)
 and lower(report_name) = lower(pl_rep_name)
 and parm_id=pl_parm_id;
 
 --WEB.SHOW_DOCUMENT('/reports/rwservlet/getjobid'|| vjob_id ||'?server='||val,'_blank');
 message('Order Slip generated');
ELSE
message ('Report failed with error message '|| vc_rep_status);
END IF;
*/

update rpt_parm 
 set rep_job_id=vjob_id ,

 where upper(report_name)=upper(pl_rep_name)

:system.message_level:=0;
